'''Waterfiend''' is an enemy encountered in the [[Temple of Aminishi]]. It is not recommended to kill these waterfiends for a [[slayer assignment]] as they are significantly stronger compared to [[waterfiend]]s found elsewhere, and do not drop anything but water runes.

In Story mode their health is reduced by 50% and their damage output is reduced by 90%.
